rules.fallback_rule: Use lower-priority source only where official identity is absent and the fallback has its own stable provider identity plus a validated crosswalk.
rules.notes: Official UFC is the preferred identity spine when a direct unambiguous relationship exists; canonical v0 may retain an already trusted Greco identity where the official relationship is missing or conflicting.
rules.selection_gate: Prefer direct official UFC UUID/FightMetric/event relationships. Never create a trusted fighter/fight identity from display-name-only matching.

rules.notes: Current rank/status/gym/listed weight are point-in-time observations, not historical truth.
rules.selection_gate: Static identity fields may reconcile across sources; mutable current profile fields require dated snapshots and may not be backfilled into old fights.

rules.duplicate_policy: For any conflicting FightMetric source-version key, do not choose first/last/newest automatically. Keep the clean Greco shared count and quarantine official-only TIP fields until a dedicated duplicate resolver promotes a version.
rules.fallback_rule: Official UFC may fill a genuinely missing Greco shared-count value only through the strict eligibility gate and with field provenance. ESPN remains additive/QA until its grain/semantics are independently promoted.
rules.qa: Across 32,342 uncontested aligned fighter-round keys, shared official-vs-Greco count fields are generally ~99.35%-100% exact; disagreements remain provenance-visible.
rules.selection_gate: Canonical v0 uses the pinned Greco/UFCStats exact fighter-round transport for this shared family. Official UFC may validate or fill a genuinely missing value only after stable fight identity, audited numeric corner mapping 0=red/1=blue, round>=1, a non-null mapped field, and no unresolved duplicate source version for that fighter-round key.
rules.versioning_note: Changing the primary shared-round transport away from Greco requires an explicit canonical dataset version/migration; it is not a silent precedence edit.

rules.notes: UFC archived control_time equals floor(Greco control seconds/60) in 97.45% of 23,876 aligned comparisons; it is coarse QA evidence, not exact seconds.
rules.selection_gate: Require exact-seconds semantics. UFC archived fight_stat.control_time is not eligible for control_sec.

rules.era_rule: Coverage is source-observed missingness, not a reason to impute. TIP coverage is near-zero before 2013; strong for most fields from 2013 onward. ground_time is specifically incomplete and reaches 0% coverage in 2023-present, so preserve nulls.
rules.notes: The minimum 0..5 fraction among populated audited position fields is >99.6%; >5 anomalies fail closed.
rules.precision_rule: Store the accepted raw integer as a floor-whole-minute bucket and interval bounds only; never synthesize an observed exact-second duration.
rules.selection_gate: Stable identified actual-round row; mapped raw value is integer 0..5; fighter-round key has no unresolved duplicate FightMetric source version. Values >5 are preserved raw but canonical-ineligible.
Resolve fighter identity; store dated observations only. Downstream historical use may select only observations strictly before the target information cutoff.

rules.notes: The transport audit covers all 10,448 rows: all dates parse as abbreviated-month MDY; 1,006 source event URLs map to 1,006 event signatures with no URL mapping to multiple signatures; exactly one duplicated (event URL, match_nr) pair spans two rows. Companion fighter-profile career totals are 2021 snapshot data and cannot be historical backfill.
rules.selection_gate: Resolve fighter identity and deduplicate UFC overlap before canonical insertion. Source dates use audited abbreviated-month MDY semantics (for example Aug 7, 2021; parser %b %d, %Y). Source event URL is the event-key candidate, and (source event URL, match_nr) is the fight-key candidate except the single duplicated pair, which must be quarantined.

rules.fallback_rule: No fallback source is canonical-approved; roster/listed weight is never a scale-weight substitute.
rules.notes: Canonical v0 contains 12,890 official UFC scale-weight observations covering 6,445 fights and 2,249 fighters. Two false Strikeforce-context transports are quarantined; 172 marker-bearing source rows retain raw marker text only.
rules.selection_gate: Canonical scale_weight_lbs requires an official UFC article observation with context-clean exact fight/fighter identity. Article publication time is not weigh-in date. attempt_number, contract_limit_lbs, missed_weight, pounds_over, catchweight_bout, purse_penalty_pct and official_status_text remain null unless source-explicit semantics are independently resolved for that observation; page-local annotation markers are never interpreted globally.

rules.fallback_rule: UFC-DataLab OCR remains raw/QA-only; MMA Decisions is reference-only under the current conservative acquisition rule.
rules.notes: Official UFC scorecard pages and selected immutable image bytes are acquired and identity-audited, but strict OCR/geometry promotion failed. The strongest physical-grid three-round sample recovered 82/270 score cells, 0/15 complete cards, and 0 complete nine-pair cards. No canonical judge-round rows are written. Images/OCR/geometry/judge reconciliation remain QA assets only.
rules.selection_gate: RAW_QA_ONLY final disposition for canonical v0. Promotion requires a future extraction method that independently recovers complete judge-round pairs from verified official source images with resolved fight/fighter/judge identity and passes result/round plausibility. Existing OCR output is not canonical.
